Sunday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. First. The beginning of the Sundays of the Resurrection. Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [AY]. "Who came for the salvation of the universe."
July 21.
Sunday. Tone 4 [BK]. Sixth. Canticle [Harts] Tone 6 [BY]. "Who descended from heaven." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [BK]. "Thy resurrection." [Barekendan] of the Fast of Vardavar.
Sunday. Tone 3 [BDZ]. Vardavar [The Transfiguration]. The post-feast period of eating meat is two weeks. See the First Volume up to the Friday of the second week, and on Saturday come here, but look here for the Canticle [Harts] of Sundays.

August
Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Second. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]. "Who in the heavenly."
Saturday. Tone 8 [DK]. Of the holy Council of Ephesus, of the two hundred Patriarchs.
Sunday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. Third. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [GDZ]. "We glorify." [Barekendan] of the Fast of the Assumption of the Mother of God.
Monday. Tone 2 [AK]. Fast of the holy Mother of God. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]. "Ineffable Essence."
Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Assumption of the holy Mother of God. The post-feast period of eating meat is three weeks. See this period in the First Volume, keeping the order of this place.
September 29.
Sunday. Tone 5 [GDZ]. Fourth. Canticle [Harts] Tone 6 [GK]. "Ineffable." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [GDZ]. "The Myrrh-bearing [women]" and "Today the resurrection." [Barekendan] of the Holy Cross.
Monday. Tone 6 [GK]. Fast of the Holy Cross. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]. "Lord God of our fathers."
Wednesday. Tone 8 [DK]. Of the Fast. Feast of the Birth of the Holy Mother of God from Anna.
Sunday. Tone 4 [BK]. Exaltation of the Cross [Khachverats]. Up to the tenth Sunday, see the First Volume; but for the Canticle [Harts] of the martyrs and of the fasts, the Resurrection Evening Hymns [Hambartsis], and those days, and the feasts of the final week, see the Sixth Year-book, keeping this month.

November.
Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Eleventh. Feast of the Presentation of the holy Mother of God. [Barekendan] of the Fast of the Fifty Days [Yisnak].
Monday. Tone 3 [BDZ]. Fast of the Fifty Days [Yisnak]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 7 [DZ]. "Lord God of our fathers."
Sunday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. First. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]. "Who for our salvation." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [ADZ]. "Who ineffable."
Monday. Tone 2 [AK]. [Feast] of Julian and Vasilouhi, and of Indos and Domna, and the others. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [BDZ]. "With the saints."

December.
Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Second. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [BDZ]. "Incorruptible." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DK]. "The Angel."
Monday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. [Feast] of Genarios and Mercurius, and of Jacob and Ira.
Tuesday. Tone 2 [AK]. Of the Egyptian fathers, Paul, Pol, and the others.
Thursday. Tone 4 [BK]. Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin from Anna.
Sunday. Tone 7 [DDZ]. Third. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]. "Unoriginate God." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [DDZ]. "Who art above." [Barekendan] of the Fast of Saint James.
Wednesday. Tone 2 [AK]. Canticle of the Fast Tone 7 [DDZ]. "Who the three children."
Sunday. Tone 6 [GK]. Fourth. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [GDZ]. "Glorified Son." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 6 [GK]. "Thy resurrection" and "Taking."
Monday. Tone 7 [DDZ]. [Feast] of Ignatius and Addai the patriarchs, and of Maruthas, and of Theopompus the bishop, and of Theonas the martyr, and the others.
Tuesday. Tone 8 [DK]. [Feast] of Abgar the king. The Scripture and Gospel readings are those of Theodosius.
Thursday. Tone 2 [AK]. [Feast] of David the Prophet and of James the Apostle.
Sunday. Tone 5 [GDZ]. Fifth. Canticle [Harts] Tone 6 [GK]. "Pre-eternal." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [GDZ]. "Glorified is thy resurrection," to the end.
Wednesday. Tone 8 [DK]. Canticle of the Fast Tone 8 [DK]. "Blessed art thou, Lord God of our fathers." [Barekendan] of the Fast of the Nativity.
